voiceSummary: GB Global Limited filed extracts of unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. Dev Land and Housing Limited is undertaking compliances for GB Global Limited pursuant to the Scheme of Amalgamation approved by the National Company Law Tribunal on 12 August 2026. GB Global Limited has been dissolved without winding up and its shares are pending delisting. Apex Capital and Finance Limited reported a net profit of 147.37 lacs for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors on 13 November 2026. Laser Power and Infra Limited reported unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026, approved by the Board on 12 November 2026. Deepak Fertilisers and Petrochemicals Corporation Limited reported unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026, approved by the Board on 13 November 2026.

attchmntText: Considered and approved the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results of GB Global Limited, along with Limited Review Reports thereon, for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026.
voiceSummary: Dev Land and Housing Limited submitted the outcome of its Board meeting held on 13th November 2026. Acting on behalf of GB Global Limited pursuant to the Scheme of Amalgamation approved by the National Company Law Tribunal on 12th August 2026, the Board noted and approved the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board also approved related party transactions for the same period. GB Global Limited has been dissolved without winding up and ceased to exist as a legal entity. Dev Land and Housing Limited is undertaking listing compliances and delisting procedures for GB Global Limited as the successor-in-interest.
